title: Rewrite lint pipeline into staged plugin architecture and add dependency-pruner adapter
author: Maya Singh
description:
Motivation: the current monolithic lint runner is brittle and causes long presubmit times; teams frequently add temporary ad-hoc checks which increase CI surface area and slow feedback. This PR introduces a staged, plugin-based lint pipeline and a first-class dependency-pruner plugin adapter so we can decouple language-specific checks, opt teams into new stages, and make presubmit runtime predictable.

Summary of changes: a) Replaces the single lint entrypoint with a staged orchestrator that executes ordered plugin phases (setup, syntax, style, safety, post-validate). b) Adds a plugin registry and a lightweight plugin interface (shim) so language/tooling teams can ship plugins (bash, python, ts, go) without touching core runner. c) Implements a dependency-pruner adapter plugin that performs a fast static analysis to recommend devdep trimming and annotates PR checks with a compact report. d) Adds a staged config file (.presubmit/stages.yaml) and an opt-in feature-flag (ci.lint.staged_v2) for gradual rollout. e) Stabilizes telemetry: stage-level timing, per-plugin success/failure counters, and a small change to the presubmit summary UI to surface plugin hints.

Why this approach: splitting the pipeline into stages lets us parallelize independent phases in future and makes it easier to target flaky checks. Plugins isolate third-party logic and let us move heavy work off the critical fastpath. The dependency-pruner is intentionally conservative (read-only analysis and CI annotation) to avoid breaking flows.

Migration & rollout: default behavior is unchanged. Teams opt-in by setting ci.lint.staged_v2=true in repo config or by adding .presubmit/stages.yaml. Rollout plan: internal dogfood on redwood/* repos for 2 weeks, then enable for top 10 active SDK repos behind the feature flag; monitoring for presubmit latency and false positives will determine next phase.

Checklist: 
- [x] Create staged orchestrator and plugin interface
- [x] Implement Python/Bash shim plugins for existing lint checks
- [x] Add dependency-pruner adapter plugin
- [x] Add metrics + telemetry + lightweight UI annotation
- [x] Add docs: docs/ci/staged-lint-plugin.md and migration guide
- [x] Add automated e2e smoke tests in perf-canary CI lane

Testing: unit tests for orchestrator and plugin loader, integration tests that run sample repo manifests, e2e smoke on ephemeral runners. I ran presubmit across redwood-sdk-python and redwood-docs to validate compatibility.

Related tickets: Linear ENG-9876, ENG-11203; support escalation SUP-438 (dep-pruner false positive during a customer migration).

Notes: this is intentionally additive and guarded by feature flags. A follow-up PR will extract plugin runners into a small go-based runner to reduce Python startup overhead; that is out of scope for this change.

review_discussion: Diego Ramos (reviewer): The plugin registry looks clean; can we add a brief contract doc for plugin authors describing required idempotency and resource limits?

Maya Singh (author): Added docs/ci/plugin-contract.md in this branch and a short summary in the migration guide. The registry enforces runtime and memory hints; see plugin_registry.py loader annotations.
Asha Patel (reviewer): Concern: dep-pruner flagged several devdeps in redwood-sdk-python that are generated files. Can dep-pruner skip generated/ and vendor/ by default?

Maya Singh (author): The adapter shipped conservative ignores for common generated patterns. I added a small heuristics list and allowed repo-specific overrides via .presubmit/pruner.yaml. Updated docs with override examples.
Liam O'Connor (reviewer): Suggest adding a non-blocking severity tag (warning vs failure) so teams can opt to treat pruner findings as advisory at first.
Maya Singh (author): Implemented severity tags and defaulted to 'advisory' when ci.lint.pruner.strict=false. See plugin config in adapter.py and stages.yaml examples.
merge: merged by squash (commit: 9a8b7c) - feature gated behind ci.lint.staged_v2; merged_at=2026-02-04
release_notes: Introduce staged lint pipeline with plugin registry and dependency-pruner adapter (opt-in via ci.lint.staged_v2). Adds stage-level telemetry, migration guide, and default advisory pruning reports. No breaking changes by default.
notes_for_ops: Enable feature flag for dogfood repos via admin console. Watch metrics: presubmit.stage.total_time, plugin.dep_pruner.detections, presubmit.flaky_rate. There is a short-lived spike in runner memory usage on first plugin load; recommend warming via ci:warm-plugin job before wide rollout.
follow_up: Follow-up work scheduled: extract plugin runner to Go (ENG-12045), add parallel stage executor and retry semantics for networked plugins, and add a pruner baseline suppressions file generator (ENG-12110).
